caption: The drawing depicts a carved wooden bird mounted on a rectangular wooden base using a single vertical dowel. The bird is depicted in profile facing left, with a long, straight beak that is dark brown. The bird’s head blends into its smoothly contoured body, which is painted in shades of reddish brown and muted gray. The wing is detailed with layered, scalloped feathers in tones of gray, blue-gray, and black, each outlined with thin black lines. The body has streaks of red and brown, with some lighter and darker patches to indicate texture and shadow. The bird’s rounded eye is highlighted with a dark outline, and its legs are not visible as they are obscured by the mounting dowel. The background of the drawing is a solid, pale beige color without any additional elements or patterns.
title: Decoy (Hudsonian Godwit)
